module: Editor utility to draw and edit with the mouse a user-defined polygon on the map (laid on the terrain). Only one polygon is managed by the module. The host tool calls handleUserPolygon every frame: click to add a node, drag to move, double-click (more than 2 nodes) to finish, Delete key to remove the selected node, Alt to show/hide the translation gizmo. render, isDragging and isMouseOverEditable let a tool that drives its own interaction stay consistent.
usage:
local poly = extensions.editor_toolUtilities_polygon
-- every frame:
poly.handleUserPolygon(function(nodes) print('polygon finished', #nodes) end, {clearOnComplete = false, snap = {ox = 0, oy = 0, step = 1}})
if poly.consumeDirty() then local p = poly.getPolygon() end
notes: The nodes are vec3; the z height is resampled on the terrain (core_terrain.getTerrainHeight).

handleUserPolygon also accepts opts.ground (boolean) and opts.open (boolean: open polyline without a closing edge), not documented in the header comment; render accepts opts.open, opts.foreground, opts.segmentLabels and opts.hover.
The edges are drawn raised 0.1 m above the terrain; a right-angle mark is displayed when a corner is within about 1 degree of square.
The double-click callback receives a deep copy of the polygon; if clearOnComplete is true (default) the polygon is then cleared.

handleUserPolygon.desc: Handles the whole lifecycle of the user polygon: rendering, cursor, adding, inserting on an edge, dragging nodes, gizmo (Alt), deletion (Delete), finishing by double-click. To be called every frame while the tool is active.

doubleClickCallback.desc: Called with a copy of the polygon on double-click when it has more than 2 nodes.

opts.desc: clearOnComplete (default true), doRender (default true), foreground (default false: drawn through geometry), snap = {ox, oy, step} (grid snapping), segmentLabels (length of each segment), rigid (dragging a node moves the whole polygon), ground, open.

render.desc: Drawing pass only, no input: displays nodes, edges and optionally segment lengths. Useful when the host tool handles its own interaction (rigid movement for example). opts.hover also makes the node under the cursor pulse.

getPolygon.desc: Returns the polygon's internal table (list of vec3, not a copy).

setPolygon.desc: Replaces the polygon with a copy of the given nodes (nil or empty = clear). Resets dragging and the gizmo, and raises the dirty flag.

isPolygonValid.desc: True if the polygon has more than 2 nodes.

clearPolygon.desc: Clears the polygon (raises dirty if it contained nodes).

consumeDirty.desc: Returns the dirty flag (polygon modified since the last call) then resets it to false.

returns.desc: true if the polygon has changed.

isDragging.desc: True while a node is being dragged; lets the host tool suspend its own scene interactions.

beginDragNode.desc: Immediately starts dragging the given node during the current mouse press, without a new click. No effect if the index is invalid.

isMouseOverEditable.desc: True if the mouse is over a node or an edge of the polygon (an edit target), to give the polygon priority over cross-tool selection.

returns.desc: true if hovering an editable element.
